description: Generic vLLM serving constraints for packed-MoE compressed-tensors artifacts.

export_lane.detail: The compressed-tensors exporter can only describe formats present in its own FORMAT_SCHEME table (config_groups metadata) plus the BF16 container passthrough, which ships as plain safetensors bf16 on the checkpoint's ignore list. Rungs outside that set (the A16 family NVFP4A16/MXFP8A16/INT8_W8A16/INT4_W4A16_g128, MXFP6, FP8_E5M2, the GGUF ggml types) have no config_groups scheme and no byte packer, so _quantize_2d raises `unsupported format` or _coerce_runtime_legal_assignment silently rewrites the Linear to BF16 -- blowing the allocated bit budget. They stay reachable on the research profile.

format_rules.detail: The selected vLLM packed-MoE serving path supports NVFP4, MXFP4, MXFP8_E4M3, FP8_E4M3, or BF16 for expert tensors; E5M2 stays research-only until a vLLM packed-MoE load smoke passes
This format is not enabled for dense Linears in the selected vLLM serving profile
